learned-weather-layer opportunity asserted

Learned regional weather

Use machine-learned weather emulators to give farming, flight, and city sims realistic, cheap, regionally coherent weather and climate variability.

Mechanic upgradehorizon 1-2 yearspriority 3.318resolves by 2028-12-31
this record asyaml sourcemarkdownjson

thesis

Game weather is a Markov chain of states or a replay of real forecasts. ML weather models from 2023 to 2025 produce physically coherent global fields orders of magnitude cheaper than numerical prediction, and ensemble methods sample plausible variability. Distilled regional emulators can drive crop growth, fire risk, flooding, and flight conditions with correlated, believable weather, including climate-shift scenarios that sims could never author.

design sketch

A farm sim ships a small emulator per biome that rolls forward daily fields (temperature, precipitation, wind) from a seed and a climate scenario. Crops, fire spread, and hydrology read those fields. Players can choose a historical climate or a warming scenario and see droughts and storms arise at realistic frequencies.

validation experiment

Distill a public ML weather model's outputs into a sub-100 MB regional emulator for one biome; compare statistics (drought frequency, storm clustering) against reanalysis data and run it inside a farming prototype at under 1 ms per in-game day. Success: matched variability statistics within 20 percent and no measurable frame cost.

key risks

  • Global models are too large for clients; distillation to regional scale may lose coherence.
  • Realistic weather can be less fun than authored seasons.
  • Licensing of model weights and training data.

falsifiable prediction

by 2028-12-31

A farming, flight, or city sim will ship weather generated by a learned emulator rather than scripted states or live forecast feeds.

Feature first shipped after 2026-10-24 in a title with at least 1,000 Steam user reviews or a console release; documentation or a developer statement describes a machine-learned weather emulator running in the shipped game.
